commercial.rentRoll: Three tenants, all triple-net: a cabinet shop, a brewer's cold store, and a guy who restores fire trucks.

hiddenIssues.desc: Floor drains in bay two run to a 1960s oil separator that has never been tested
Dock leveler in bay one is seized and has been chained open

blurb: Twenty-one thousand feet on the spur, three tenants who pay their own taxes. Boring in the way that compounds.
